name: io.github.achubnet/agentalarm
title: AgentAlarm
description: Notifications, reminders and alarm-style alerts on the user's iPhone. Sign in with OAuth.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Clients sign in with OAuth and the user allows it in the AgentAlarm iPhone app. A Bearer <key> also works: get one in the app under Settings > Connected Agents > Connect.
